name: hip-adduction-cable
title: Hip Adduction: Cable
primer: This exercise strengthens the hip adductors, the muscles of the inner thigh.
steps: Stand alongside a cable pulley stack and attach a cuff to the pulley and your ankle.
Step away from the stack, holding onto the stack for support.
Stand firm on the foot not attached to the cable and slowly adduct, or pull, your cuffed ankle in front of your stabilizing leg.
